reviews.title: Pay More, Get Nowhere
reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 — The only thing this game is good at is emptying your wallet.

Welcome to the endless cycle of “Want more CP? PAY.”
Need better stats? PAY.
Want to upgrade your gear? PAY.
Want to improve your chances? PAY.
And after spending hundreds of dollars, you know what the solution is when you’re still stuck?

PAY EVEN MORE.

The funniest part is that many of these “luck-based” systems feel less like luck and more like a carefully designed casino where the house always wins. You spend money, press the button, and then the game basically tells you: “Good luck, sucker.”

After throwing a ridiculous amount of money into this game, I eventually realized something: I wasn’t actually getting stronger. I was just paying to climb one or two more floors before hitting another wall designed to make me spend again.

And don’t expect much meaningful interaction between players either. The community feels increasingly empty because many long-time players are simply leaving. It’s not hard to understand why when the monetization is this aggressive.

After a few months, I finally accepted that the money I’d already spent was gone and deleted the game.

Let’s be honest: this is basically an idle version of the original game, designed to turn your wallet into the real endgame.

There is no amount of CP that will ever be enough, because the game will always give you another reason to spend more.

My advice: DON’T SPEND A SINGLE CENT.

Not $100.
Not $10.
Not even $0.01.

Save your money. Save your time. Save yourself the frustration.

Because in this game, the real boss isn’t the enemy.

It’s your credit card. 💳💀

Thanks for reading.

reviews.title: Fun game ruined by guilds
reviews.text: I think the base content of maplestory idle RPG is addicting, but being kicked by two guilds has turned me away from the game. I logged into the game at least once daily to make sure I did all of the daily tasks, including build guild construction and help requests, but the guild leaders can still arbitrarily kick you. This is a problem for two reasons: one, guilds give you damage bonuses (without them you are too weak to beat certain missions. So being in a guild is largely not optional). And two, guilds are not free to create. So you are at the mercy of creepy players who ask you for your personal info to join the guild, only to maybe kick you the next day. The blame is fully on maplestory for making guilds so small and offering incentives to quickly recycle guild members (why take somebody who logs in every 2 days if you can get somebody who logs in every day? Or maybe 2-3 times a day). Exhausting

reviews.title: Fun for a little
reviews.text:
Overall the gameplay is fun, you get some nostalgic MS vibes early on. 
The progression is pretty quick until it isn’t. After a certain point you are waiting on weekly resets to get resources to increase combat power to progress. You can bypass a lot of this if you want to throw and endless amount of money at the game but a lot of the whales that post in Reddit pretty much say it’s not worth it. Now for me I’m free to play and can hold my own against ptw for the most part. 
There are too many aspects in this game and different functions that make being free to play slower than the pay to win crowd. Nexon will always pander to the pay to win. 
There are decent events that seem to be constantly going on. Some are fun and some are terrible. The flag race was abysmal and a drag to do. You would even randomly not get credit for doing it. 
Colosseum events have been occurring twice a week and Nexon allows players to manipulate their combat powers in order to get into lower ranked matches just so they can re equip much stronger gear and be 2-3x stronger than everyone else. 
Nexon also doesn’t punish players for verbal abuse or questionable names. 
Overall the game is fun for a bit but starts to lose its luster as the progression comes to a complete halt for weeks at a time. If you want a game where you can just throw money at to get ahead this would be perfect for you. If you want to be free to play that’s fine and you can have fun and enjoy it. But you get throttled pretty hard later on. Corsair class is terrible compared to everyone else. 

I put 2 stars because Nexon doesn’t moderate this game the way they should. When you have concerns and open tickets you get ai slop responses about how it’s not their fault and also the fact that they allow people to manipulate their combat power to win at the colosseum.
